skills.limits: Only survival primary +2 is proposed from the approved occupation default. Secondary +1 requires a biography and is not assigned. travel_transport has no equivalent in the current player skill schema; riding means horseback and remains neutral. Typed gap: player_watercraft_skill_missing. No boat or ferry capability, equipment, route knowledge or biography is granted.

language.limits: Only ordinary speech is transferred. No boatman role, ethnic identity, place of birth, reading ability or foreign language is inferred.

knowledge.limits: Empty lists mean no authored specific facts, routes or persons. They do not erase ordinary competence or claim universal ignorance. Initial visible facts enter only through committed source perception and existing knowledge owner. No known place is inferred from physical placement.

runtime_limits: Data approval only; no target import, release activation, existing-player mutation or historical population claim.
Canonical NPC composition, current scene/source proof, target catalogs and operational approvals remain separate gates.
